SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_all, COUNT(specieskey) AS n_specieskey, COUNT(taxonkey) AS n_taxonkey, COUNT(kingdom) AS n_kingdom, COUNT(countrycode) AS n_countrycode, COUNT(level0gid) AS n_level0gid, SUM(CASE WHEN hascoordinate = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_hascoordinate, SUM(CASE WHEN hasgeospatialissues = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_no_geospatial_issue, SUM(CASE WHEN occurrencestatus = 'PRESENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_present, SUM(CASE WHEN basisofrecord <> 'FOSSIL_SPECIMEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_not_fossil, SUM(CASE WHEN coordinateuncertaintyinmeters IS NULL OR coordinateuncertaintyinmeters <= 100000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_uncertainty_ok, SUM(CASE WHEN hascoordinate = TRUE AND hasgeospatialissues = FALSE AND occurrencestatus = 'PRESENT' AND specieskey IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_where_core
FROM occurrence
